objective: Preregister up to 6 (here 5) daily [0,1] exposure-multiplier guards on the unchanged T1 12-1 momentum book, covering all 3 required published families (Daniel-Moskowitz bear/panic state, Barroso-Santa-Clara daily realized-vol scaling, a market-crash circuit breaker and/or book-level stop) plus 2 natural extensions (their product; a market-level counterpart to the book-level stop), judged against G1/G1'/G2/G3/G4/G5 on the frozen select/holdout/anchor windows, with every threshold either published or computed only on the 2016-01-04..2023-09-15 development window.

bear_indicator.definition: SPY cumulative close-to-close return over the trailing 504 sessions (~24 months) < 0
bear_indicator.provenance: published (Daniel & Moskowitz 2016, 24-calendar-month lookback, generalized to trading sessions)

high_vol_indicator.definition: SPY trailing 126-session annualized realized vol (sqrt(252 * mean(r^2))) > its own median over the development window
high_vol_indicator.threshold: median of the same rolling series over 2016-01-04..2023-09-15, computed by the runner script (not hand-picked)
high_vol_indicator.provenance: window published (DM 2016 Table 5, 126-day trailing market variance); threshold computed on development window only, per this card's rule

parameters.multiplier_rule: 0.0 while panic_state is true (as of the prior close), else 1.0
parameters.settlement_lag_basis: SPY close-to-close series; 1-session lag is standard (no book-return settlement quirk)
parameters.expected_behavior: May trigger rarely or never in 2023-2026 (no 24-month SPY decline in this bull-market window); this is a pre-registered honest expectation per external-brief.md, not treated as a bug if observed.

variance_forecast.formula: sigma_hat_t^2 = mean(book_10bp_net_return^2 over trailing 126 sessions); annualized sigma_hat_t = sqrt(252 * sigma_hat_t^2)
variance_forecast.input_series: T1 book's own 10bp-net daily return series (open-to-open convention), not gross and not the guarded series
variance_forecast.provenance: published formula (Barroso & Santa-Clara 2015 eq. 5/6), generalized from their monthly update cadence to a daily update per this task's explicit instruction

parameters.target_vol: median of the same trailing-126-session annualized vol series over the development window (2016-01-04..2023-09-15, intersected with available book-return history from 2017-01-03), computed by the runner script -- NOT BSC's own 12% (disclosed as not directly transferable to a concentrated long-only book, see bsc2015_target_12pct claim)
parameters.multiplier_rule: min(1.0, target_vol / sigma_hat_t); cap 1.0 per this card's instruction (no leverage)
parameters.settlement_lag_basis: book's own open-to-open return series; ret[i] not fully known until open[i+1], so a naive 1-session lag would leak one unsettled observation -- see decision-record.md

trigger.definition: unguarded T1 book's own 10bp-net cumulative equity drawdown from its running peak <= -T_dd
trigger.T_dd_formula: clip(1.5 * (book's own max drawdown magnitude over the development window, 2016-01-04..2023-09-15 intersected with available history) * 0.5, 0.12, 0.30)
trigger.provenance: reuses docs/plan-strategy-factory-2026-09-22.zh.md section 1's existing sleeve kill-switch formula (1.5x(dd)x0.5, clipped to [12%,30%]), substituting the development window for the anchor window that formula normally reads, since the anchor window may not be used to fit any threshold in this round

reentry_rule.definition: re-enter (multiplier back to 1.0) once the UNDERLYING (unguarded) book's own cumulative equity closes at or above its own trailing 50-session SMA
reentry_rule.provenance: fixed, mechanical rule computed only from the always-available unguarded book equity curve; avoids circularity of an SMA computed on a guard-flattened (cash) equity curve

parameters.multiplier_rule: 0.0 while triggered and not yet re-entered, else 1.0
parameters.settlement_lag_basis: book's own open-to-open equity/drawdown series, same lag reasoning as CG-BSC-daily

parameters.multiplier_rule: cg_dm_multiplier(t) * cg_bsc_daily_multiplier(t), using the identical component definitions and thresholds already fixed for cg_dm and cg_bsc_daily (no re-fitting)
parameters.settlement_lag_sessions: inherits each component's own lag (1 for the DM leg, 2 for the BSC leg; the product uses each series exactly as computed for its own candidate)
parameters.rationale: Tests whether combining the two required published families performs better than either alone; belt-and-suspenders, not a new mechanism.

trigger.provenance: published (SEC/NYSE Market-Wide Circuit Breaker Level 1, a real single-day 7% S&P 500 decline threshold, claim secgov_mwcb_levels) -- not fit to any local window

reentry_rule.definition: flat (multiplier 0.0) for a fixed N sessions after the trigger session, then automatically back to 1.0 regardless of market state
reentry_rule.N_sessions_method: N = round(median number of sessions for SPY to close back above its pre-drop level, across all development-window (2016-01-04..2023-09-15) sessions with a single-day return <= -7%); if fewer than 3 such development-window events exist, N defaults to a disclosed round value of 5 sessions (one trading week), stated in report.md as not data-derived in that case
reentry_rule.provenance: re-entry duration is a portfolio-management choice the SEC rule does not specify; computed from development-window recovery behavior where feasible, disclosed honestly where it falls back to a round number

parameters.multiplier_rule: 0.0 for N sessions following a trigger session (re-triggerable if a new -7% session occurs while still flat, extending the flat period), else 1.0

data_v1_daily_broad_and_sip_momentum_cra.source: alpaca SIP daily archive (data/sip/daily) for SPY/SHY/BIL; the repo's own daily_broad/universe_broad feature tables (already hygiene-sanitized via open_composer.research.features.price_hygiene.sanitize_price_matrices) for the T1 book itself
data_v1_daily_broad_and_sip_momentum_cra.hygiene: T1 book prices: existing sanitize_price_matrices pipeline (unchanged, reused). SPY/SHY/BIL: drop zero-volume/zero-trade-count ghost bars.

feature_v1_t1_book_and_guard_signals.t1_book: momentum_252_21 signal, top_n=500 universe (equivalent to top_n=3000 restricted to tier 1, verified identical since adv_rank is precomputed independent of the top_n load filter), top-30 cohorts, 20-session overlapping hold -- open_composer.research.signal_card.{load_market,load_signal,topk_cohorts,hold}, unchanged
feature_v1_t1_book_and_guard_signals.guard_signals: spy_bear_indicator_504d, spy_realized_vol_126d, book_realized_vol_126d_settled, book_drawdown_settled, spy_single_session_return -- see strategy_specs/drafts/momentum_crash_guard_h20260924_02.yaml factors section for definitions; computed by scripts/run_h20260924_02_momentum_crash_guard.py

label_v1_daily_guarded_book_return.definition: daily guarded-book net return series: (scaled_held * ret).sum() - turnover(scaled_held)*cost_bps/1e4 + (1-multiplier)*shy_next_open_return, where scaled_held = base T1 held-weight matrix * multiplier[:,None]; reported at 10bp and 20bp per side

validation_v1_frozen_windows_g1_g5_momen.gates: G1 anchor CAGR>=50% and max DD<=35%; G1' anchor Sharpe>=2.0 and CAGR>=30%; G2 holdout Sharpe>=1.0 and holdout return>0; G3 <=10% of 20 calendar-shifted (1-20 session) guard-multiplier placebos match or beat the real guard's anchor Sharpe; G4 G1 or G1' still holds at 20bp; G5 long-only, Alpaca-executable.
validation_v1_frozen_windows_g1_g5_momen.stress_disclosure: each candidate also reported on 2016-01-04..2023-09-15, disclosure only, never a gate
validation_v1_frozen_windows_g1_g5_momen.sharpe_convention: excess of BIL daily return, ddof=1, sqrt(252) annualization -- reused unchanged from scripts/run_h20260918_05_recent_menu.py::metrics for exact consistency with the frozen protocol's other reported numbers
